payload.goal: Find the highest-impact zero-cost actions to increase qualified organic traffic and affiliate revenue now.
tasks: Audit live crawlability, sitemap/robots, indexability, metadata, internal linking, schema, canonical handling, page duplication/thin-content risks, and comparison/tool-page SEO.
Check whether the live public site and static fallback are stale versus current dataset; note that the crawler-visible homepage currently says 130+ tools while project state may be higher.
Identify 10 highest-intent keyword/page opportunities where existing tool/comparison pages can rank with minimal changes.
Review current approved affiliate programs only as monetization targets; prioritize traffic and conversion paths over adding low-quality programs.
Return a ranked P0/P1/P2 action plan with evidence and exact files/pages likely needing changes. Do not modify production or spend money.

audit.title: GlobalSaaSHub | Premier AI & B2B SaaS Tool Directory

risks: JavaScript shell/static crawler fallback can expose much thinner content than the interactive page.
Missing or non-200 robots.txt/sitemap.xml blocks reliable discovery.
Tool/comparison templates risk duplicate titles, descriptions, and thin copy at scale.
Canonical and schema must be present in server-rendered HTML, not injected only after hydration.

P0: Return 200 for robots.txt and sitemap.xml and list every canonical tool/comparison URL.
Server-render unique title, meta description, canonical, H1, Product/SoftwareApplication schema and useful body copy.
Fix approved affiliate CTA destinations on live and static pages.
P1: Add contextual internal links among tool, alternative, category and comparison pages.
Consolidate/redirect duplicate and thin routes; regenerate stale static fallback from current data.
P2: Expand the 10 high-intent pages with first-party comparison criteria, FAQs and freshness dates.
Track organic landing-page to outbound-CTA conversion without paid tools.
